text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Bearing the name of the sacred land of 
theater――the Takarazuka Kinen. In the very 
domain that could be called the castle of 
this opera-loving monarch, standing 
alongside me was... Doto!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Cinderella eagerly awaits the dance at the 
castle. And looking on with jealousy are 
her spiteful stepsisters (the other 
contenders)!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Will the victor be me, the master of the 
castle, the princess... or perhaps the 
wicked step-sisters!?

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Now! The curtain rises on our court drama, 
the Takarazuka Kinen—!
